heading.en: Why does hot tea cool fast at first?
heading.kn: ಬಿಸಿ ಚಹಾ ಮೊದಲು ಏಕೆ ಬೇಗ ತಣ್ಣಗಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?

hook.en: A cup of tea drops from very hot to warm quickly, but then takes a long time to reach room temperature. The rate of cooling depends on how much hotter it is than the room.
hook.kn: ಚಹಾ ಬಹಳ ಬಿಸಿಯಿಂದ ಉಗುರುಬೆಚ್ಚಗೆ ಬೇಗ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಕೋಣೆಯ ತಾಪ ತಲುಪಲು ಬಹಳ ಸಮಯ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ. ತಂಪಾಗುವ ದರ ಕೋಣೆಗಿಂತ ಎಷ್ಟು ಬಿಸಿ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿದೆ.

objectives.en: Use the average form to solve cooling problems

body.en: The rate of loss of heat of a body is proportional to the difference between its temperature T and the temperature T_s of its surroundings, provided the difference is small: −dQ/dt = k(T − T_s). The temperature therefore falls exponentially towards T_s, fast at first and slowly later.
body.kn: ವಸ್ತುವಿನ ಉಷ್ಣ ನಷ್ಟದ ದರ ಅದರ ತಾಪ ಮತ್ತು ಸುತ್ತಲಿನ ತಾಪದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ (ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಚಿಕ್ಕದಿದ್ದಾಗ). ತಾಪ ಘಾತೀಯವಾಗಿ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: A cup of tea at 90 degrees cools in a room at 30. It cools fast at first, then more and more slowly.
The rate of cooling is proportional to the excess temperature over the surroundings, when the excess is small.
Solving, the excess temperature decays exponentially.
For problems use the average form. A body cools from 80 to 50 degrees in 5 minutes in a room at 20. First find K.
Now the time to cool from 60 to 30 degrees: the excess is smaller, so it takes longer: 9 minutes.
A check: log of the excess temperature against time is a straight line with slope minus K.

body.en: For a body cooling from T₁ to T₂ in time t, use the average temperature: (T₁ − T₂)/t = K[(T₁ + T₂)/2 − T_s]. Find K from one interval, then use it for another.
body.kn: T₁ ರಿಂದ T₂ ಗೆ t ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ತಂಪಾದರೆ: (T₁ − T₂)/t = K[(T₁ + T₂)/2 − T_s]. ಒಂದು ಹಂತದಿಂದ K ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿದು ಇನ್ನೊಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಬಳಸಿ.

problem.en: A body cools from 80 °C to 60 °C in 5 min in a room at 20 °C. How long will it take to cool from 60 °C to 40 °C?

body.en: Each equal drop in temperature takes longer than the one before, because the body is closer to room temperature. Check your answer: the second time must be larger.

homework.en: Water cools from 60 °C to 50 °C in 10 min in a room at 25 °C. Find the time to cool from 50 °C to 40 °C.

narration.en: Recap. Rate of cooling ∝ (T − T_s), for small differences. The cooling curve falls exponentially. Use the average temperature for interval problems.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ತಂಪಾಗುವ ದರ ∝ (T − T_s), ಸಣ್ಣ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸಕ್ಕೆ. ತಂಪಾಗುವಿಕೆಯ ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆ ಘಾತೀಯವಾಗಿ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಂತರ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಸರಾಸರಿ ತಾಪ ಬಳಸಿ.
